```{r}

coverage_files <- list.files(
    pattern = "\\.coverage\\.tsv$"
)

coverage_df <- coverage_files |>
    map_dfr(
        ~read_tsv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
            mutate(
                Sample = tools::file_path_sans_ext(
                    tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(.x))
                )
            )
    )

#head(coverage_df)
```


```{r}
coverage_summary <- coverage_df |>
    group_by(Gene) |>
    summarise(
        Samples_total = n(),
        Samples_over95 = sum(COVERAGE >= 95),
        Percent_over95 = round(
            Samples_over95 / Samples_total * 100,
            1
        )
    )

#coverage_summary
```

```{r}
coverage_heatmap <- ggplot(
    coverage_df,
    aes(
        x = Gene,
        y = Sample,
        fill = COVERAGE,
        text = paste0(
            "Sample: ", Sample,
            "<br>Gene: ", Gene,
            "<br>Coverage: ", round(COVERAGE,1), "%",
            "<br>Depth: ", round(MEANDEPTH,1)
        )
    )
) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
        name = "Coverage (%)",
        limits = c(0,100)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=8)
    )

ggplotly(coverage_heatmap, tooltip="text")
```

```{r}
depth_heatmap <- ggplot(
    coverage_df,
    aes(
        x = Gene,
        y = Sample,
        fill = MEANDEPTH
    )
) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
        name="Mean depth"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

ggplotly(depth_heatmap)
```

```{r}
resistance_files <- list.files(
    pattern="\\.resistance\\.tsv$"
)

resistance_df <- resistance_files |>
    purrr::map_dfr(
        ~read_tsv(
            .x,
            col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
        ) |>
        mutate(
            Sample = tools::file_path_sans_ext(
                tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(.x))
            )
        )
    )


if(nrow(resistance_df)==0){
  cat("No characterised resistance mutations were detected.")
} else {
  summary_table <- resistance_df |> mutate(across(ends_with("EC50_ratio"), as.numeric)) |> pivot_longer(cols = ends_with("EC50_ratio"), names_to="Drug", values_to="EC50") |> mutate(Drug = str_remove(Drug,"_EC50_ratio"))

  summary_table <- summary_table |> group_by(Sample, Gene, Mutation, Drug) |> summarise(Mean_EC50 = mean(EC50, na.rm=TRUE), Publications = n(), .groups="drop")

  summary_table <- summary_table |> mutate(Resistance = case_when(Mean_EC50 <2 ~ "Susceptible", Mean_EC50 <5 ~ "Low", Mean_EC50 <15 ~ "Medium", is.na(Mean_EC50) ~ "Unknown", TRUE ~ "High"))

  summary_table <- summary_table |> select(-Mean_EC50, -Publications) |> pivot_wider(names_from = "Drug", values_from = "Resistance") |> select(Sample, Gene, Mutation, Ganciclovir, Foscarnet, Cidofovir, Maribavir, Letermovir) |> arrange(Sample, Gene, Mutation)


  tbl <- gt(summary_table)
  tbl <- tbl |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "grey"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Unknown"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "green"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Susceptible"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "yellow"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Low"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "orange"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Medium"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "red"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "High"
      )
    ) |>
```
